tools.set: Shows or hides each view's design image from .rbrowser/designs/ over the page and sets opacity, blend mode, invert, anchor, offset, split view and the design per breakpoint - one setting for every view, each view showing its own design. Answers the state and each view's design. Without arguments it answers the state unchanged.
tools.designs: Lists the design images in .rbrowser/designs/ with their size in px, file size and export scale (or why one is unusable), and whether a design can be added (an open project in a trusted workspace). With path, hash and chunk it answers that chunk of a design's bytes as base64; with thumb (a design's hash) the small preview the panel kept, and with thumb and data (a PNG of at most 256 px a side, base64) it keeps one. Designs are added by a person with the Add design command; choose one per breakpoint with imageoverlay_set.

designs.label: Design per breakpoint
designs.description: A design image per breakpoint id, as a path below .rbrowser/designs/ (designs/mobile.png). A breakpoint without an entry shows the design nearest to its width: the width in the file name (home-1440.png), else the image's width. Paths outside .rbrowser/designs/ are refused.
designs.help: A design image per breakpoint id, as a path below .rbrowser/designs/. Example: mobile to designs/mobile.png. A breakpoint without an entry gets the design nearest to its width, read from the file name (home-1440.png) or the image.

opacity.label: Opacity (%)
opacity.description: How opaque the design is over the page, 0 to 100.
opacity.help: How opaque the design is over the page, in percent; 50 shows both, 100 covers the page. Example: 30 for a faint guide.

blend.label: Blend mode
blend.description: How the design mixes with the page: normal, or difference (identical pixels turn black), multiply, screen, overlay, exclusion.
blend.help: How the design mixes with the page: normal lays it over, difference turns identical pixels black (a perfect match goes dark), multiply, screen, overlay and exclusion for other comparisons.

invert.label: Invert the design
invert.help: Shows the design's colours inverted, useful with the difference blend to spot small offsets.

anchor.label: Position
anchor.description: Pinned to the page: the design scrolls with the page. Fixed in the view: it stays in place in the view.
anchor.help: Pinned to the page lets the design scroll with the page; Fixed in the view keeps it in place, for sticky headers.

autoScaleDpr.label: Scale @2x and @3x exports
autoScaleDpr.description: Shows an export named name@2x.png or name@3x.png at its CSS size (the image's pixels over the scale), and prefers the export matching a view's pixel ratio. Off: every design shows at one image pixel per CSS px.
autoScaleDpr.help: Shows an export named name@2x.png or name@3x.png at its CSS size and prefers the one matching a view's pixel ratio. When off, it shows every design at one image pixel per CSS px.
